notes: Screenshot: press S on a paper, Alt S (⌥S on a Mac) anywhere, or the button at the foot of the marking tools. Drag over what you want, click a page for the whole page, or press Enter for the whole screen, and the picture is copied, ready to paste. On a paper, name covers stay painted in and the student’s name and file name are left off; With my marks chooses whether your marks come too.
